name: Better village controls
author: irongete
description: A polity's groups run 0 to 254 while the client draws eight colours, so every colour row that spends the whole of that space -- the Village and Realm tabs of the Kith & Kin window, and the member panel that puts a person in a group -- grows a picker beside it carrying every group the server takes. It shows the group the row is in, which above the eighth colour is all a group has, and picking one drives the row the way a click on a square would. Every row of the kin roster and of a member list also carries its group's number at the right edge. The Kin tab's own colour row and the claim window's are left with their eight squares: the claim keeps eight permission rows and no more, and a kin group above the eighth is a label nothing in the game spends.
